answer: Joint-liability sponsorship blocks bulk fakes: a newcomer joins only when an established agent stakes 200 units for 15 epochs. Cheating forfeits the newcomer's 100-unit stake, slashes the sponsor 50% and bars it 10 epochs, while the graph exposes any gale of copycats. A cipher-bound credential ties each sponsorship to one key, so renting reputation is a relic: 1,000 fakes need 500 sponsors risking 100,000 units, with 30% caught losing 45,000.
